title: 2025-04 Catch-up pace and event cadance complaints

meta.Event: Catch-up pace and event cadance complaints

source: After launch, the CN server rapidly caught up with other servers by running events back-to-back at half the JP duration, while event shop costs remained unchanged and no stamina was granted, sharply reducing effective rewards; the official Bilibili comment sections saw large-scale player complaints. (Source: NGA community public threads)
